title: Relics and the Relic Forge
text: Relics are weapons and worn items from many anime and webtoon worlds. They climb the seven Tensura grades without changing item. Relics below Legend need no attunement. Craft the Relic Forge (gold ingot, diamond, gold ingot / obsidian, crafting table, obsidian / three iron ingots) to upgrade a relic with catalysts, socket Spirit or Devil Cores, draw them back out, and engrave Tensura enchantments on weapons. Head and feet relics use the Curios slots. A relic hits harder in the hands of an awakened, large-pool player.
